result.title: From Sorry to QED: Refining LLM Math Proofs via Angelic Execution
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can now generate Lean proof scripts that capture the high-level structure of many mathematical arguments. However, these scripts frequently fail on complex theorems: a single missing side condition or misapplied lemma can cause the prover to abort early and discard an otherwise viable proof outline. This paper presents MathEye, a framework that converts imperfect LLM-generated proof scripts into fully verified Lean proofs by combining symbolic reasoning with minimal human interaction. At the core of MathEye is angelic proof checking, an optimistic execution model that replaces failing proof fragments with placeholders while preserving the overall structure of the argument. This optimistic check produces an angelic proof that isolates the exact proof obligations that the LLM fails to discharge. Because these unresolved obligations are often logically interdependent, asking a mathematician to address every placeholder directly is inefficient. To minimize human effort, MathEye performs residual analysis over a proof dependence graph that captures symbol-level data flow in the angelic proof. By formulating obligation selection as a MaxSAT optimization problem, MathEye selects a minimal-cost set of essential obligations whose resolution suffices to complete the entire proof. MathEye presents these essential obligations to the mathematician in ordinary mathematical language and uses the mathematician's answers to automatically reconstruct the complete Lean proof. Experiments on 30 real-world benchmarks across analysis and algebra show that MathEye solves 93.3% of the problems while reducing the number of required user interactions by 55%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MathEye 框架：以「angelic 检查」这一乐观执行模型把 LLM 生成 Lean 脚本中失败的片段替换为占位符，从而保留论证结构并隔离出未完成的证明义务；再在符号级数据流依赖图上做残差分析，把义务选择形式化为 MaxSAT，挑出最小代价的关键义务交由数学家以自然语言回答，并自动重建完整可验证证明。
AI.relevance_reason: 乐观执行加占位符残差、以及最小义务集的选取，可供核查 LVR 中中间推理状态的贡献分配与最小干预验证思路（哪些 latent 步骤真正必需、如何以最少补全修复推理链）；但其属形式化证明修复，尚无视觉或多模态证据，迁移属推测。
